Benvenuto Cellini and Sovereignty Claim Major Victories at Keeneland Breeders' Cup

01 Nov 2026, 06:14 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.theguardian.com

European-trained runners faced a challenging outing at the Breeders' Cup meeting at Keeneland, securing just a single victory on the card, though it came in the high-profile $5m Turf courtesy of Benvenuto Cellini and jockey Ryan Moore.

Moore executed a late surge from the inside rail to secure a three-quarter length victory. The triumph marked Aidan O'Brien's 28th victory at Group One or Grade One level in 2026, tying the record he established in 2017. O'Brien noted that Moore maintained composure throughout the race, expertly navigating traffic to secure the win.

Feature Race Results

  • Breeders' Cup Classic ($7m): Won by Sovereignty, the 2025 Kentucky Derby winner trained by Bill Mott. The victory marked a first Classic success for the Godolphin racing and breeding operation. Last year's winner, Japan's Forever Young, finished fifth.
  • Breeders' Cup Turf ($5m): Won by Benvenuto Cellini, ridden by Ryan Moore.
  • Breeders' Cup Mile: Won by Deterministic, defeating the previous year's winner, Notable Speech.
  • Breeders' Cup Sprint: Won by T O Elvis, representing Japan.
  • Breeders' Cup Distaff: Won by Nitrogen under jockey Jose Ortiz.

International Contenders and Future Venues

Several prominent European contenders fell short during the Saturday card. Charlie Appleby's Notable Speech finished second behind Deterministic in the Mile, while multiple Group One winner Blue Bolt and the Irish 1,000 Guineas winner Precise finished unplaced in the Filly & Mare Turf.

The Breeders' Cup is scheduled to move to Belmont Park next year for the first time since 2005, following significant redevelopments by the New York Racing Association.

Verification and Practical Information

Official results, race replays, and full event statistics can be verified through the official Breeders' Cup website or recognized racing authorities such as Equibase.
